messages.subject: Using Shapefile created in QGIS
parts:
Hello,

I have a question regarding how you would use a shapefile generated in QGIS. I'm at the step where I would like to merge the datafile I generated that has the plot information (fieldMap) to the Shapefile I created. I have already done the step below 

library(rgdal) ShapeFile <- readOGR("Other_Software_ShapeFile.shp")

Essentially I want to tie everything together like the next step

EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil, ncols = 14, nrows = 9, fieldMap = fieldMap, fieldData = DataTable, ID = "Plot")

instead of creating ncols and nrows, i want to use my Shapefile. How does one go about that?

Thanks!

Mason Lien

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Using Shapefile created in QGIS
parts:
Hi Mason Lien,

Thank you for asking...!!!

Unfortunately, FIELDimageR does not allow it yet. The algorithm in fieldShape function always create plots from left to right, and from top to bottom, which helps to avoid errors of merging datafile (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P5). 

Merging datafile with shapefile from other software using FIELDimageR could have some problems due to (1) different plot configuration, where the plot identification does not follow the definition above "left to right and top to bottom", or (2) the field design could not be following a matrix configuration with columns and lines. 

I will work on that as soon as I have time and I will get back to you. I don't know how your field looks like, but I guess the function fieldPolygon can help you. Please check it here: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P15 

My suggestion is to merge the information from your datafile to your ShapeFile using direct QGIS tools and import to the R later.

Best,
Filipe
